title: Purportedly AI-Recreated Clips from Beastie Boys' 'Sabotage' Video Reportedly Appeared in FBI Promotional Video Posted by Kash Patel

behaviors.text: An FBI promotional video posted by Director Kash Patel reportedly used AI-generated clips that closely recreated shots from the a person' 1994 "Sabotage" music video directed by a person.
NPR identified at least six matching clips and quoted experts who said AI likely recreated the footage, possibly from screenshots or short clips.
